texts.facts: No notice is being issued to respondent Nos.1 and 2, in view of the order which is being passed. 2. Petitioners claim to be the wholesale Raw Fish merchants doing business in Sakthanthampuran Non Vegetarian Public Market at Thrissur. It has been further submitted that there is a dispute with regard to the retailers, and petitioners have already filed W.P.(C) No.16803 of 2014 before this Court regarding the same, which is pending.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that notice for agitation with effect from 28.08.2014 has been given by respondents 1 and 2. He submits that in the event petitioners are unable to do the business, that shall cause great loss. 3. Learned Government Pleader submits that petitioners have not impleaded the Municipality which is controlling the market and further, in so far as the inter se dispute between the petitioners and retailers, the matter is pending consideration in another writ petition.
